jds.title: Financial Analyst
jds.description: Fresher Financial Analyst supporting FP&A / MIS. Build monthly dashboards, variance bridges, and management reports. Excel, Financial modeling, MIS, Variance analysis expected; articleship or finance internship is a plus. Portfolio or internships preferred. Preferred certifications: CFA Level 1 (candidate), Financial Modeling & Valuation (FMVA-style), NSE/NISM financial markets certification.
